thread:
Leah: Quick follow-up to the migration RFC: proposing an "edge harmonizer" shim that accepts legacy request shapes and emits the new runtime contract. Opt-in per-tenant flag. Main tradeoffs: where to handle streaming frames and how to keep cache keys stable.
Arun: Opt-in makes sense. Concern: streaming semantics differ (legacy uses raw content frames, new runtime emits structured deltas). Reframing at edge avoids runtime branching but pushes ownership to gateway.
Noah: I prototyped a small Envoy filter that rewrites the first metadata frame and wraps subsequent chunks. Median overhead was tiny; p99 increased ~4-6ms on burst. Still within SLA for beta.
Leah: Double-serialization is the enemy. If edge does the transform, we avoid runtime forks. But gateway teams will need tests, security sign-off, and perf tickets.
Vera: Cache compatibility: if field names change, prefix/KV cache misses will spike. We need a canonicalization function so transformed keys map back to the original cache buckets or vice versa.
Arun: Propose header gating: X-Compat: legacy->new and X-Compat-Mode: best-effort|strict. Best-effort forwards original on failure with warning header; strict returns 422. Also emit X-Harmonizer-Applied when successful.
Noah: Pseudocode from staging:
```
if header == "X-Compat: legacy->new":
  if is_stream:
    map first_frame_metadata() -> new_header_frame
    stream map_following_frames()
  else:
    try transform(body)
    if fail:
      if tenant_mode == "strict": return 422
      else: add header X-Harmonizer-Warn and forward original
```
Leah: Telemetry required: harmonizer_invoked, harmonizer_latency_ms, harmonizer_bytes_in, harmonizer_error_count. Tag with tenant_id and route. Trace IDs must flow end-to-end.
Vera: Ops-bot: please add alert rule - page if harmonizer_error_rate > 1% across >=5 tenants for 10m and dashboard panel "Edge Harmonizer - latency/errors".
ops-bot: Added alert "harmonizer_error_rate" and dashboard panel.
Arun: Tool arg mappings are tricky: if we alias parameter names, downstream tool contracts could break. Best to whitelist harmless aliases and record tombstone of original payload to storage if tenant enables debug.
Noah: Security note: transformations must be declarative maps only, no template execution or eval. All mappings audited and sandboxed.
Leah: Rollout plan: internal dev tenants (3) -> partner beta (10) -> 50 tenants -> broad. Canary gates: harmonizer_error_rate, p99 latency delta, cache_hit_ratio. Rollback via tenant flag flip or remove filter from edge.
Vera: Add RBAC so only platform-release and tenant-ops can flip opt-in. Ops will run perf runs to validate p99 across varied payload sizes.
Noah: I'll produce a compact Envoy Lua reference + a C++ hook sketch and perf numbers (ETA 72h).
Leah: I'll draft the migration playbook, mapping whitelist, and strict-mode semantics (ETA 24h).
Arun: Long-term: if >20% of traffic uses harmonizer, consider migrating mappings upstream into runtime and deprecate edge shim.
Vera: I'll coordinate security review and add dashboard panels for invocations by tenant.
Leah: Action items summarized: Noah -> prototype + perf (72h), Leah -> playbook + mapping doc (24h), Vera -> security + RBAC (48h). Revisit after artifacts. :white_check_mark:
